title: Prime Minister congratulates Indian 4×400m Relay team on winning Bronze at Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has congratulated Dharmveer Chaudhary, Manu TS, Jay Kumar and Vishal TK on winning the Bronze medal in the Men’s 4×400m Relay at the Asian Games with a superb timing.
The Prime Minister said that it was a spirited team effort and a fitting podium place. He extended his best wishes to the athletes for their upcoming endeavours and expressed hope that they continue to make India proud.
Shri Modi said that the success will go a long way in inspiring other athletes.
The Prime Minister’s Office said in X post;
“Congratulations to Dharmveer Chaudhary, Manu TS, Jay Kumar and Vishal TK on winning Bronze in the Men’s 4×400m Relay with a superb timing. It was a spirited team effort and a fitting podium place. My best wishes for their upcoming endeavours. May they keep making India proud. This success will go a long way in inspiring other athletes: PM @narendramodi”
